name: SuiteFixtureSetup
summary: Runs once before the tests of a suite and once after them, so that an expensive fixture is built one time for many tests.

roles.name: SuiteFixtureSetup
roles.summary: The framework's one-time hook. It is where a shared fixture is legitimately built, and it is the point at which every test in the suite becomes able to affect every other — which is why what it builds should be the part no test modifies.
